g8.angular_assumption: isotropized conditional on each exact single-site excitation
g8.removal_scope: separate assumed favorable zero, not a binding-energy measurement

g9.frame: bulk crystal Cartesian x100 y010 z001; n_in=+[111]/sqrt(3); s=displacement dot n_in, positive into chosen metal half-space
g9.mapping: z_target=Z0+s, arrival shift=s/v at fixed ballistic speed; reverse sign for the opposite slab normal
g9.consumer_scope: table import and frozen-ballistic mapping only; pinned g9 generic lab z has no crystallographic surface or density CSV API
g9.transverse_meaning: marginal integrates whole plane perpendicular to n; on_axis_line_density separately retained, not interchangeable
g9.surface_scope: not a slab target or target offset; actual slab geometry remains a future input
